# Shares — Style Reference

> Frosted glass slats over a white ledger, backlit in violet. Aeonik 400 headlines in plum-black ink sit on a white canvas, 1px grey hairlines do the line work, and violet exists only as light behind the glass.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Shares uses an ink-on-paper infrastructure language. The canvas is white #ffffff, with secondary planes at #f6f6f6 and #f7f7f7, an inverted #1f1f1f announcement strip, and one plum-black ink, #20192b, which carries 57 text instances and the primary button fill. The interface owns no color. The chromatic budget for chrome is zero, and every saturated hue is quarantined inside full-bleed gradient imagery. Brand violet #594ff4 survives only as an inherited, overridden link value. Typography splits the work across three families: Aeonik at weight 400 for every heading from 20px to 48px, Inter 400 at 12px and 14px for running and legal copy, and Aeonik Mono 500 uppercase with 0.8px tracking for eyebrows. Size alone carries hierarchy. The scale climbs 24, 32, 48 in Perfect Fourth and Perfect Fifth steps, with no bold anywhere. Every button and image panel takes the same 4px corner, and nothing casts a shadow. Tonal planes and 1px #d9d9d9 hairlines handle separation. The result reads as a settlement ledger rather than a consumer fintech app.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page body, solution-card backdrop, hero "Get in touch" fill and white text on dark bands (13 uses). It is the ledger page that lets the imagery carry all the light. |
| Mist Panel | `#f6f6f6` | `--color-mist-panel` | Secondary section planes and quiet content wells (2 uses). It separates zones tonally so no border or shadow is needed. |
| Fog Surface | `#f7f7f7` | `--color-fog-surface` | Secondary button fill for "Explore Treezor" and other outbound links. It is one step off white, which makes it a demoted action rather than a competing one. |
| Jet Bar | `#1f1f1f` | `--color-jet-bar` | The announcement strip above the nav, the only inverted chrome band on the page. It reads as a teleprinter ticker, not a promotional banner. |
| Onyx Backdrop | `#000000` | `--color-onyx-backdrop` | Base layer beneath the hero gradient image and dark media wells (2 uses). It guarantees white headline contrast when imagery loads late. Do not use it for text. |
| Plum Ink | `#20192b` | `--color-plum-ink` | All headings, body copy, eyebrows and the primary button fill (57 text uses plus 2 fills). The violet undertone ties the ink to the imagery without spending a hue. |
| Graphite Text | `#333333` | `--color-graphite-text` | Inherited default on card wrappers, image containers and the footer shell. It works as a fallback ink, so visible copy should still resolve to Plum Ink. |
| Pewter Caption | `#999999` | `--color-pewter-caption` | "READ MORE" in the announcement bar and the trusted-by label (5 uses). It is the tertiary voice, readable but deliberately recessive. |
| Ash Border | `#d9d9d9` | `--color-ash-border` | 1px vertical rules bounding the logo strip and divider hairlines (3 uses). It is the system's only line work. |
| Amethyst Glow | `#594ff4` | `--color-amethyst-glow` | Inherited link color on solution-card anchors and the hue family of the hero gradient. It is a brand memory, not an interface color. Do not promote it to button fills, headings or body links. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Aeonik — the display and UI grotesk, set at 400 for every heading · `--font-aeonik`

- **Substitute:** Satoshi at 400, Geist at 400, Albert Sans at 400. Aeonik Regular draws slightly lighter and more open than Inter at the same nominal weight, so keep substitutes at 400 and do not step up to 500 for headings.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 14px, 20px, 24px, 32px, 48px
- **Line height:** 1.05 at 48px, 1.15 at 32px, 1.3 at 24px, 1.5 at 20px, 1.143 at 14px
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at all sizes
- **Role:** Weight 400 at 48px is the signature: the headlines are large and quiet, and they convey authority through restraint instead of emphasis. Weight 500 appears only on 14px button and nav labels, so the heavier cut marks things you click, not things you read. The steps run 20→24 at 1.2 (Minor Third), 24→32 at 1.333 (Perfect Fourth) and 32→48 at 1.5 (Perfect Fifth). Hierarchy therefore widens as it climbs, which is anti-convention against the uniform Major Third most SaaS sites use. Zero tracking at display sizes leaves Aeonik's geometric apertures untouched.

### Inter — the reading and disclosure face for small copy · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 (freely available, use directly), Roboto at 400, IBM Plex Sans at 400. Plex draws slightly heavier, so pair it with Plum Ink rather than darkening it further.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.5 at 12px, 1.5 at 14px, 1.143 at 14px for single-line labels
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at 12px and 14px
- **Role:** Inter takes the copy no one admires but everyone must read: card descriptions, footer disclosures and the regulatory paragraphs about Shares Financial Assets. It holds a single weight across 32 elements. Splitting display (Aeonik) from reading (Inter) is a deliberate, legal-department division of labor. The brand voice stays geometric, and compliance text stays maximally legible at 12px.

### Aeonik Mono — the uppercase micro-label for eyebrows and tickers · `--font-aeonik-mono`

- **Substitute:** Geist Mono at 500, JetBrains Mono at 500, IBM Plex Mono at 500. Aeonik Mono Medium renders close to its nominal weight, so match 500 directly.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px
- **Line height:** 1.667 at 12px, 1.375 at 12px in compact strips, 1.429 at 14px
- **Letter spacing:** 0.8px at 12px, 0.6px at 14px
- **Role:** The mono face is the technical annotation layer: "SOLUTIONS", "TRUSTED BY LEADING FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS" and the announcement ticker. Uppercase plus 0.8px tracking at 12px (0.067em) is a tabulated, terminal register. It signals infrastructure without a single code snippet on the page. It appears 14 times and never drives a heading.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Aeonik Mono | 500 | 12px | 1.667 | 0.8px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 400 | 12px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Aeonik | 500 | 14px | 1.143 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Aeonik | 400 | 20px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Aeonik | 400 | 24px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading | Aeonik | 400 | 32px | 1.15 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Aeonik | 400 | 48px | 1.05 | 0px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every heading in Aeonik weight 400, from 20px up to 48px — size is the only hierarchy lever, and restraint at display scale is the signature.
- Use #20192b for all readable ink and for the primary button fill — one plum-black that matches headlines keeps the action and the argument in the same voice.
- Hold every button and image panel at 4px radius — a single corner value across buttons, cards and images is what makes the system read as engineered.
- Put saturated color inside gradient imagery only, at full bleed or within 4px-radius panels — the chrome stays at zero hues and the imagery becomes the brand.
- Mark sections with Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500 uppercase at 0.8px tracking — the technical eyebrow signals infrastructure without code samples.
- Separate zones with tone (#f6f6f6, #f7f7f7) or 1px #d9d9d9 hairlines — elevation by plane shift keeps the page flat like a printed statement.
- Give statement headings 144px of vertical air and default sections 96px — whitespace is the luxury signal here, not ornament.

### Don't

- Don't bold the headlines to 600 or 700 at 48px — heavy display weight turns quiet authority into a sales shout and breaks the thesis that size alone carries rank.
- Don't fill the primary button with #594ff4 violet — the moment the CTA takes a hue, the imagery loses its monopoly on color and the page becomes a generic fintech landing page.
- Don't add box-shadows to cards or buttons, not even a 1px soft blur — the system is shadowless by design, and floating objects contradict its flat, ruled ledger logic.
- Don't round buttons into pills or cards to 16px — anything past 4px softens the institutional register into consumer-app friendliness.
- Don't set body copy in Aeonik at 12px — legal and descriptive text belongs to Inter 400 at 12px and 14px, and the three-family split is non-negotiable.
- Don't color the mono eyebrow or wrap it in a badge with a #f6f6f6 fill — eyebrows are bare 12px ink annotations, and a container turns them into marketing chips.
- Don't use #333333 as the visible body ink — it is an inherited fallback, and mixing it with #20192b produces two near-blacks that never quite match.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f7f7f7 (Fog Surface)
- primary text: #20192b (Plum Ink)
- tertiary text: #999999 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #d9d9d9 (Ash Border)
- inverted chrome: #1f1f1f (Jet Bar)
- primary action: #20192b (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts render in neutral ink only, with #20192b lines and 1px #d9d9d9 gridlines on #ffffff, and #594ff4 is permitted as a solid fill for at most one highlighted series so the data never outshouts the headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #20192b, text color #ffffff, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 16px 24px, total height 48px, font-family Aeonik (fallback Satoshi, then the system sans stack) at 14px weight 500 with line-height 1.143 and 0px letter-spacing, and no box-shadow. Build a sibling secondary variant with background #f7f7f7 and text #20192b, identical radius and padding, plus a trailing 12px external-link icon placed 8px after the label. Neither variant changes color on hover beyond an opacity shift; do not add a violet state.

2. Build a Solution Card row: a 3-column grid inside a 1224px container with 16px column gaps. Each card has no background, no border and 0px padding. It starts with a square image panel at border-radius 4px holding a ribbed gradient image (decorative colors, not tokens). Then follow a 24px gap, a title in Aeonik 24px weight 400 line-height 1.3 color #20192b, a 12px gap, a description in Inter 14px weight 400 line-height 1.5 color #20192b, a 24px gap, and a Primary Action Button. Above the grid, place an eyebrow in Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500 uppercase with 0.8px letter-spacing in #20192b, then 24px below it a heading in Aeonik 32px weight 400 line-height 1.15.

3. Build a Hero Section: a full-bleed block with background #000000 under a full-cover photographic gradient of vertical violet light ribs, with 0px radius. Above it, add a full-bleed announcement bar, background #1f1f1f, 24px tall, centered text in Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500 uppercase with 0.8px letter-spacing in #ffffff, followed by "READ MORE" in #999999 at an 8px gap. Inside the hero, align an H1 to the left edge of the 1224px container near the bottom with 48px below it, set in Aeonik 48px weight 400, line-height 1.05, 0px letter-spacing, color #ffffff, wrapping over two lines.

4. Build a Navigation Bar: a transparent, position-relative (not sticky) bar 48px tall inside the 1224px container, overlaying the hero. Put a white wordmark on the left. On the right, add "Solutions" with a 12px chevron and "About us", each Aeonik 14px weight 500 color #ffffff with padding 16px 24px, followed by a CTA with background #ffffff, text #20192b, border-radius 4px, padding 16px 24px, Aeonik 14px weight 500. Use no border, no backdrop blur and no shadow.

### Solid Button — Fog (Secondary)

**Role:** Outbound or subsidiary destination link

A demoted twin. The spec is background #f7f7f7, text #20192b, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 16px 24px for a 48px height, Aeonik at 14px weight 500, a trailing 12px external-link glyph set 8px from the label, and no shadow. **Role:** Contact action on dark imagery

The inverted primary. The spec is background #ffffff, text #20192b, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 16px 24px, height 48px, Aeonik at 14px weight 500 with line-height 1.143, and no shadow. "Get in touch" sits at the right end of the nav over the violet hero. It is the same object as the Plum button with fill and ink swapped. The system keeps one shape and inverts its value against the backdrop instead of introducing a third button style.

**Role:** Global wayfinding and contact entry

### Announcement Bar — Ticker

**Role:** Corporate news strip above navigation

A teleprinter line. ### Hero Banner — Full-Bleed Gradient

**Role:** Brand statement over imagery

A backlit curtain. The spec is a full-bleed photographic gradient of vertical violet light ribs over a #000000 backdrop, with radius 0px. The H1 "The infrastructure shaping the future of finance" is set in Aeonik 48px weight 400, line-height 1.05, 0px tracking, #ffffff, bottom-left aligned to the 1224px container edge with 48px of air below. The headline sits low and left like a caption on a photograph. The imagery speaks first and the claim lands quietly.

### Logo Strip — Trusted By

**Role:** Social proof from institutions

A ruled marquee. The spec is a #ffffff band with the label "TRUSTED BY LEADING FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS" in Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500, uppercase, 0.8px tracking, #999999 on the left. Client marks scroll horizontally on the right inside two 1px #d9d9d9 vertical hairlines, with 0px radius and no card. The client logos keep their own marks (a teal dot, red letterforms), which are decorative and not system tokens. The hairlines frame the proof as a table row rather than a carousel.

### Statement Heading — Centered

**Role:** Problem framing between sections

A single centered thesis. The spec is Aeonik 48px weight 400, line-height 1.05, #20192b, text-align center, constrained to roughly 70% of the 1224px container so it breaks into three balanced lines, with 144px of vertical white space around it. There is no eyebrow, no body copy and no illustration. "Legacy systems are fragmented…" works as a pull quote that relies entirely on scale and silence.

### Eyebrow Label — Mono

**Role:** Section category marker

An uppercase ticker tag. The spec is Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500, uppercase, 0.8px tracking, line-height 1.667, #20192b, no background, no border, sitting 24px above a 32px Aeonik heading such as "Discover your next financial offering". It replaces the colored pill badge that convention would put here. The section is named in the register of a data feed, and the heading stays the only display-scale element in view.

### Solution Card — Image-Led

**Role:** Product vertical entry point

Imagery as the container. The spec is no background, no border, padding 0px, one third of a 3-column grid with 16px gutters, and a square image panel at 4px radius. Below the panel come a 24px gap, the title in Aeonik 24px weight 400 #20192b, a 12px gap, the description in Inter 14px weight 400 line-height 1.5 #20192b, a 24px gap, and the button. The wrapper carries a top-only 4px corner. The card has no chrome of its own: the panel is the card.

### Gradient Image Panel — Glass Mockup

**Role:** Product preview inside imagery

The system outlier, deliberately so. Each square panel at 4px radius holds a ribbed gradient field (violet for Wealth, coral-to-violet for Workplace, steel blue for Treezor; all decorative, not system tokens) with a frosted translucent UI tile floating inside. The tile shows a portfolio chart, a savings balance or a payment card in white type. This is the only place saturated color is permitted. Quarantining hue inside imagery lets the panels carry the brand while every surrounding pixel stays ink and paper.

- Use #20192b for all readable ink and for the primary button fill — one plum-black that matches headlines keeps the action and the argument in the same voice.
- Hold every button and image panel at 4px radius — a single corner value across buttons, cards and images is what makes the system read as engineered.
- Put saturated color inside gradient imagery only, at full bleed or within 4px-radius panels — the chrome stays at zero hues and the imagery becomes the brand.
- Mark sections with Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500 uppercase at 0.8px tracking — the technical eyebrow signals infrastructure without code samples.
- Separate zones with tone (#f6f6f6, #f7f7f7) or 1px #d9d9d9 hairlines — elevation by plane shift keeps the page flat like a printed statement.
- Give statement headings 144px of vertical air and default sections 96px — whitespace is the luxury signal here, not ornament.

### Don't

- Don't bold the headlines to 600 or 700 at 48px — heavy display weight turns quiet authority into a sales shout and breaks the thesis that size alone carries rank.
- Don't fill the primary button with #594ff4 violet — the moment the CTA takes a hue, the imagery loses its monopoly on color and the page becomes a generic fintech landing page.
- Don't add box-shadows to cards or buttons, not even a 1px soft blur — the system is shadowless by design, and floating objects contradict its flat, ruled ledger logic.
- Don't round buttons into pills or cards to 16px — anything past 4px softens the institutional register into consumer-app friendliness.
- Don't set body copy in Aeonik at 12px — legal and descriptive text belongs to Inter 400 at 12px and 14px, and the three-family split is non-negotiable.
- Don't color the mono eyebrow or wrap it in a badge with a #f6f6f6 fill — eyebrows are bare 12px ink annotations, and a container turns them into marketing chips.
- Don't use #333333 as the visible body ink — it is an inherited fallback, and mixing it with #20192b produces two near-blacks that never quite match.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | Page body, card backdrop, logo strip |
| 1 | Mist Panel | `#f6f6f6` | Secondary section planes and quiet wells |
| 2 | Fog Surface | `#f7f7f7` | Secondary button fill, demoted actions |
| 3 | Jet Bar | `#1f1f1f` | Inverted announcement ticker |
| 4 | Onyx Backdrop | `#000000` | Base under hero imagery and dark media |

## Elevation

Shares uses zero box-shadows across 13 sections. Elevation is replaced by tonal layering: white #ffffff steps to #f6f6f6 and #f7f7f7 for secondary planes and inverts to #1f1f1f and #000000 for chrome and media bases. Single 1px #d9d9d9 hairlines rule the logo strip. Depth that would conventionally come from shadow comes instead from the gradient imagery, where frosted glass tiles float inside the picture rather than above the page. The UI feels like a printed annual report with photographic plates, not a stack of floating cards.

## Imagery

Imagery is abstract photographic gradient. The images are light passing through vertical ribbed glass, rendered in violet for the hero and Wealth panel, coral fading to violet for Workplace, and steel blue for Treezor. All of these hues are decorative and outside the system tokens. Product screenshots appear only as stylized frosted mockups composited inside the gradients: a portfolio balance with a line chart, a savings figure, a payment card with a chip and masked number. Panels are framed square at 4px radius with no border and no shadow, sitting directly on #ffffff. The hero runs full-bleed at 0px radius. Icons are minimal 1px-stroke glyphs (chevron, external link) in the current text color. There are no orbs or glows as tokens, because the gradients exist only as raster imagery. The narrative is infrastructure seen through glass: the product is the light, the interface is the frame.

## Layout

Content lives in a 1224px container, and a full-bleed hero and announcement bar break out of it. Sections breathe at 96px, with 144px reserved for the centered statement heading. The hero is a full-bleed gradient with the 48px H1 bottom-left, followed directly by a ruled logo marquee. Sections alternate between centered single-statement blocks and left-aligned eyebrow-plus-heading blocks over grids. Solutions run in a 3-column grid with 16px gutters, and the logo row scrolls horizontally inside hairlines. The nav is transparent over the hero, positioned relative (not sticky), 48px tall, with the wordmark left and Solutions, About us and a white CTA right. The footer is a tall white block with 48px side padding and Inter 12px legal paragraphs. At 375px, the display role drops to 32px, sections tighten to 48px, and grids collapse to one column. Overall density: spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- secondary surface: #f7f7f7 (Fog Surface)
- primary text: #20192b (Plum Ink)
- tertiary text: #999999 (Pewter Caption)
- hairline: #d9d9d9 (Ash Border)
- inverted chrome: #1f1f1f (Jet Bar)
- primary action: #20192b (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts render in neutral ink only, with #20192b lines and 1px #d9d9d9 gridlines on #ffffff, and #594ff4 is permitted as a solid fill for at most one highlighted series so the data never outshouts the headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor with background #20192b, text color #ffffff, no border, border-radius 4px, padding 16px 24px, total height 48px, font-family Aeonik (fallback Satoshi, then the system sans stack) at 14px weight 500 with line-height 1.143 and 0px letter-spacing, and no box-shadow. Build a sibling secondary variant with background #f7f7f7 and text #20192b, identical radius and padding, plus a trailing 12px external-link icon placed 8px after the label. Neither variant changes color on hover beyond an opacity shift; do not add a violet state.

2. Build a Solution Card row: a 3-column grid inside a 1224px container with 16px column gaps. Each card has no background, no border and 0px padding. It starts with a square image panel at border-radius 4px holding a ribbed gradient image (decorative colors, not tokens). Then follow a 24px gap, a title in Aeonik 24px weight 400 line-height 1.3 color #20192b, a 12px gap, a description in Inter 14px weight 400 line-height 1.5 color #20192b, a 24px gap, and a Primary Action Button. Above the grid, place an eyebrow in Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500 uppercase with 0.8px letter-spacing in #20192b, then 24px below it a heading in Aeonik 32px weight 400 line-height 1.15.

3. Build a Hero Section: a full-bleed block with background #000000 under a full-cover photographic gradient of vertical violet light ribs, with 0px radius. Above it, add a full-bleed announcement bar, background #1f1f1f, 24px tall, centered text in Aeonik Mono 12px weight 500 uppercase with 0.8px letter-spacing in #ffffff, followed by "READ MORE" in #999999 at an 8px gap. Inside the hero, align an H1 to the left edge of the 1224px container near the bottom with 48px below it, set in Aeonik 48px weight 400, line-height 1.05, 0px letter-spacing, color #ffffff, wrapping over two lines.

4. Build a Navigation Bar: a transparent, position-relative (not sticky) bar 48px tall inside the 1224px container, overlaying the hero. Put a white wordmark on the left. On the right, add "Solutions" with a 12px chevron and "About us", each Aeonik 14px weight 500 color #ffffff with padding 16px 24px, followed by a CTA with background #ffffff, text #20192b, border-radius 4px, padding 16px 24px, Aeonik 14px weight 500. Use no border, no backdrop blur and no shadow.

## Quarantined Color

The discipline is that the interface owns no hue. Every saturated pixel on Shares lives inside a raster gradient: the violet hero, the coral Workplace panel, the blue Treezor panel. Chrome, type and actions resolve to #20192b, #ffffff and three greys. The rule breaks the moment #594ff4 leaks onto a link, a button fill, an icon or a focus ring, because the imagery stops being the brand and becomes illustration. To extend the system, add new verticals as new gradient panels in a fresh hue family, each confined to a 4px-radius square. New UI states (errors, success, focus) should be expressed through Plum Ink weight, 1px #d9d9d9 or #20192b outlines and tonal fills before any status hue is considered. A status color, if ever required, stays at status-dot scale.

## Quiet Display Weight

Weight 400 at 48px is the authority mechanism. Shares states its largest claims ("The infrastructure shaping the future of finance") in the same weight as a card title, so scale and whitespace (96px and 144px) do all the ranking. Conventional fintech sites jump to 600 or 700 for heroes, and doing so here would collapse the measured, institutional calm into a pitch. Weight 500 is rationed to 14px clickable labels, which keeps "heavier" synonymous with "actionable". To extend the system, add new heading levels only by size, stepping down from 32px to 24px to 20px, keep tracking at 0px, and let line-height loosen as size falls (1.05, 1.15, 1.3, 1.5). Any emphasis inside a headline should come from a line break, not a bold span.
